title: The Burnt Deadline
author: Mirabel Villalobos
blurb: Sebastian Eriksen, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
